messages:
Clare: Quick heads-upVerdantix saw a recurring morning latency hump during their marketing batch (08:30-09:00 UTC). p95 token latency rose ~270ms for ~20m. Renewal check-in in 5 days; want a low-risk perf proposal.
Hank: Any pattern on request types? streaming vs non-streaming, prompt lengths, burst QPS?
Clare: Mostly non-streaming completions; median prompt ~170 tokens, response ~130. Bursts are parallel marketing jobs that kick off at top of the hour. No OOMs.
Suresh: Trace peek: queue latency climbs when continuous batch >5. Example: [08:33] id=vm12 model=redwood/dialogue-v2 seq_in=168 seq_out=132 batch=7 p95=980ms.
Clare: Proposed concise plan (low-risk, observable): 1) run a 90m shadow (A/B logging) of a micro-quant path redwood/micro-lite-v1:int8, 2) after shadow, start a 12% canary with semantic-anchor gating, 3) session-sticky for streaming so we don't switch mid-session, 4) split routing 70% dedicated / 18% hosted fallback / 12% canary.
Nora (Verdantix): We require parity on our public templates. Shadow + semantic gating sounds reasonable but need a quick human QA pass on our 10 compliance templates.
Hank: Good call. We'll run automated diffs (BLEU + embedding cosine) and require embedding mean_cosine >= 0.989 and max per-sample drop <= 0.01 before allowing canary to escalate. Also include a manual spot check (1 QA reviewer, 10 samples).
Suresh: Ops tweaks: reduce continuous_batch_size_limit for their dedicated pool from 64 -> 46 during shadow+canary, pre-warm top-20 prefixes, set kv_prefetch_ttl=80s to stabilize cache. Also enable adaptive kernel selection for the int8 path.
Clare: Rolling rollback policy suggestion: auto-revert if p95 > baseline + 180ms for 10m OR error_rate > 0.6% for 5m OR semantic_anchor_mean < 0.989. Also keep a cost-savings estimate in the runbook (approx -28% per-token cost if migration completes).
Nora (Verdantix): Good to have the cost estimate. Can you include a short list of QA prompts? I'll have our QA lead approve.
Clare: Will attach 10 templates to the calendar invite. Ops snippet for route I plan to run in the canary window:
```
route: verdantix-shadow-canary
- match: customer_id == "verdantix"
- weights: {dedicated:70, hosted_fallback:18, canary:12}
- canary_model: redwood/micro-lite-v1:int8
- session_sticky: true
- autoscale_headroom: 0.22
- continuous_batch_size_limit: 46
- kv_prefetch_ttl_s: 80
- semantic_anchor_threshold: 0.989
- rollback_conditions: {p95_delta_ms:180, error_rate_pct:0.6}
```
Hank: ops-bot, please schedule shadow run and create alerts: verdantix-shadow-p95, verdantix-shadow-semantic, verdantix-canary-auto-revert. Add a 2h retention difflog for A/B samples.
ops-bot: Shadow scheduled: verdantix-shadow-5123456789; canary job template created: verdantix-canary-5123456789; monitors created: p95_tokens, error_rate, semantic_anchor_mean; auto-revert configured per requested thresholds.
Suresh: I'll provision +1 GPU to their dedicated pool for the first 3 hours and watch queue latency. Also enabling token-level difflogging and retention=48h for quick QA.
Nora (Verdantix): Thanks  Please include our QA lead on the invite at 15:00 UTC tomorrow. If shadow+QA pass, we can consider stepping the canary to 40% over 90m.
Clare: Action items: Clare attach eval prompts + invite QA, Hank & Suresh implement pool limits + pre-warm + GPU, ops-bot run shadow and canary monitors. I'll post shadow metrics and a short runbook summary here after the 90m window. :white_check_mark:
